title: The Telegram Timestamp Contradiction
description:
📂 Evidence Folder #7:
Witness A: 'I received the victim's telegram at 2:00 PM.'
Telegraph Office Record: Telegram was dispatched at 4:00 PM.
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: You cannot receive a telegram before it is sent.
solution: Witness A claimed receipt 2 hours prior to dispatch.
